hooks.command: f=$(node -e "const fs=require('fs');const d=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(0,'utf8'));process.stdout.write((d.tool_input&&d.tool_input.file_path)||'')"); if [ -n "$f" ] && [ -f "$f" ]; then ./node_modules/.bin/prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f"; case "$f" in *.js|*.jsx|*.ts|*.tsx) ./node_modules/.bin/eslint --fix "$f";; esac; fi; true
